newsitem.title: THAILAND: Thai baht drops late, interbank rate rises.
newsitem.headline: Thai baht drops late, interbank rate rises.

text.p: The Thai baht was down sharply against the dollar in late trade on Friday as the U.S. unit surged abroad, dealers said.
The baht fell to 25.980/25.985 late from 25.967/25.972 in the morning, they added.
Dollar demand was also boosted by some dollar short covering ahead of the long weekend, dealers said.
Foreign exchange and money markets will be closed on Monday for a public holiday.
"The (dollar) buying will continue next week because some players could not cover their (dollar) position today," said one dealer at a foreign bank.
The overnight interbank rate was up sharply to 10.00-10.50 percent late from 9.50 in early morning on high demand for funds ahead of the weekend, dealers said.
Banks also retained funds to buy the rising dollar today, dealers said.
The one-month baht/dollar swap premium was quoted at 6.50/7.00 satangs per dollar late compared with 6.50/7.50 in early trade, dealers said.
